productname: Annie Chocolate Velvet Barrel Chair w/Casters
productdescription: Meet the Annie Velvet Barrel Chair in cotton color, where style meets everyday ease. Designed with sleek tuxedo arms and a smooth, curved silhouette, it brings a modern, tailored look to any space. Four independent casters make it easy to move wherever you need extra seating. Wrapped in soft cotton-colored velvet, it feels incredibly luxurious to the touch, while the 100% polyester fabric keeps it durable and easy to care for-perfect for real life without sacrificing comfort or sophistication.
techspecs:
* Crafted of 100% polyester fabric in ivory color, pine and poplar solids, engineered wood and foam
* Chair is solidly constructed to support up to 275 pounds in weight
* Five independently rotating casters on each leg offer effortless mobility for smooth and easy movement
* The chair's soft-touch ivory fabric, crafted from 100% polyester ensures plush comfort and a luxurious dining experience, exceptional protection, fade-resistance, and easy maintenance for long-lasting beauty and convenience
* Versatile side chair suitable for dining, office, or living areas, serving as a stylish accent piece
* Cleaning Code SW: Spot clean using a small amount of mild dish soap mixed with water. Gently blot the area with a clean, soft cloth-do not saturate. Allow to air dry.
* Available in gray, brown and white fabric
